summary: Recorded the current account for the live-cluster receipt a1c98fc2bafd4775aa05275dd25f2767 (31 events, exit 0) and closed the registered repair gap: comparison 0 is violated with a valid witness at parsed index 26 — the restarted follower held no configuration at all while its leader stayed in Leader state and its log already matched (last log index 113, last applied 110, no snapshot), so ordinary AppendEntries did not re-derive it — and comparison 2 holds at parsed index 27, where the configuration entry the leader appended afterwards (index 114, three voters) became the follower's configuration; both flag-disabled controls hold at indices 29 and 30. gap-0 is marked resolved with that executed basis plus the source-only snapshot boundary, a fact for the live-cluster durability and repair path was added, the duplicate-entry behaviour now cites this receipt, and the discriminator moved to the remaining narrow question: whether an empty reconstruction also disables the membership and voter gates on the vote path, letting a restarted node grant support to a peer that is not a voter in the committed configuration. Incomplete: the vote-path probe is not built yet, and disk-backed stores, crash semantics and multi-follower configurations remain unexercised.
